## Osisko Gold Appoints Vice President, Construction Operations for the Cariboo Gold Project


TORONTO, Nov. 02, 2026[(GLOBE NEWSWIRE)](https://www.globenewswire.com/) -- **Osisko Gold Group Inc.** (NYSE: OGG, TSXV: OGG) (" **Osisko Gold** " or the " **Company** ") is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Cameron Carter as Vice President, Construction Operations of Barkerville Gold Mines Ltd., the Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, effective immediately. Mr. Carter will oversee construction execution currently underway at the Cariboo Gold Project (the " **Project** "), located in central British Columbia. Reporting directly to Sean Roosen, Chairman and CEO, he will work alongside JDS Energy & Mining Inc., the Project's principal construction management contractor.


**Sean Roosen, Chairman and CEO, commented:** *"We are excited to welcome Cameron to the Osisko Gold team. He brings a strong technical background and extensive expertise in building large-scale underground mines globally. His commitment to safety, building high-performing teams, and operational excellence, together with his disciplined approach to project delivery will be invaluable as we advance the Cariboo Gold Project through construction and commissioning and into production."*


Mr. Carter brings more than 18 years of experience in underground mine development, construction, operations, and executive leadership. Throughout his career, he has held progressively senior roles in mine engineering, operations management, project delivery, and commercial and business development. Mr. Carter joins from Dumas Mining, where he spent more than 15 years, most recently serving as Senior Vice President, providing executive leadership across the technical and commercial functions of its international underground mining business. During his tenure, he supported the successful execution of complex underground mining projects, including El Limon and Media Luna (Torex Gold Resources Inc.), La Colorada and Bell Creek (Pan American Silver Corp.), and Lalor (Hudbay Minerals Inc.), among others, while helping strengthen the organization's technical capabilities, operational systems, and project delivery practices. Earlier in his career, Mr. Carter contributed to the development and construction of Glencore's Mine D project at Kidd Operations in Northern Ontario, one of the world's deepest base metal mining operations. Mr. Carter holds a Bachelor of Applied Science (B.A.Sc.) from Acadia University and a Bachelor of Mineral Resource Engineering (B.Eng.) from Dalhousie University. He is a licensed Professional Engineer in the Province of Ontario.


The Company also announces that Sarah Harrison, Vice President, Permitting and Compliance, is leaving the Company, effective immediately, to pursue other opportunities. Greenwood Environmental Inc. (" **Greenwood** ") has assumed responsibility for permitting and compliance matters, and Ms. Harrison will remain available in an advisory capacity. " *We thank Sarah for her efforts and contributions to Osisko Gold and wish her continued success in her future endeavours,* " noted Sean Roosen. Greenwood has led or supported permitting and environmental assessment processes for several major projects in British Columbia, including Mt. Milligan and Red Chris.


**ABOUT OSISKO GOLD GROUP INC.**


Osisko Gold Group Inc. is a continental North American gold development company focused on past producing mining camps with district-scale potential. The Company's objective is to become an intermediate gold producer through the development of its flagship, fully permitted, 100%-owned Cariboo Gold Project, located within the Company's broader Cariboo regional land package in central British Columbia, Canada, which hosts numerous prospective exploration targets and provides opportunities for future discoveries. Its Cariboo project pipeline is complemented by the Tintic Project, located in the historic East Tintic mining district in Utah, U.S.A., a brownfield property with significant exploration potential, extensive historical mining data, and access to established infrastructure. Osisko Gold is focused on developing long-life mining assets in mining-friendly jurisdictions while maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation, development risk management, and mineral inventory growth.
